column1: # The glossary scripts/translation-check.py holds each translation to, and the machine pass translates with.
# One row per term. `en` is matched as a case-insensitive word prefix (so "relay" also finds "relays"); a locale
# cell lists the renderings that count, separated by |, each matched as a case-insensitive substring (write a
# stem, like "bloque" for bloquear / bloqueado / desbloquear). keep=yes: every locale writes the term as is, and
# the same-as-English check ignores it. Mirror a change into the translator instructions on Weblate.
